data.title: In HelloNation, Expert Chiropractor Dr. Craig Peterson Details How Quickly You Can Feel Relief After a Chiropractic Adjustment
data.description: The severity of the condition, the consistency of treatment, and the individual's response all play a part in determining how soon chiropractic care yields results. data.title: Federal Reserve Rate Hike Reinforces Trend of Longer Vehicle Ownership
data.description: With the recent Federal Reserve rate hike causing an increase in borrowing costs, it is advisable for more individuals in the U.S. to prolong the usage of their vehicles. data.title: FHU Reports Record Graduation Rate Amid Strong Fall Enrollment
data.description: In Henderson, Tennessee, as of September 18, 2026, Freed-Hardeman University has successfully enrolled a total of 2,296 students for the fall semester. This rate surpasses the graduation rates of nine other institutions, signifying the university's commitment to academic success and student advancement.

data.title: Research Frontiers Welcomes Gauzy’s Court-Approved Restructuring and the Restart of SPD-Smart Light Control Film Production
data.description: Woodbury, New York, on September 18, 2026 - Research Frontiers Inc. (Nasdaq: REFR), known for its patented SPD-SmartGlass technology, acknowledged the approval from Gauzy Ltd. regarding the final court approval of its debt settlement plan. data.title: Generation Mining Agrees to a Term Sheet with the Ontario Government for Funding to Support Construction of the Marathon Processing Facility
data.description: In Toronto, Generation Mining Limited (TSX: GENM) (OTCQB: GENMF) has announced a positive development. The company agreed to a non-binding term sheet with the Government of Ontario for the construction of a mineral processing facility at its Marathon Copper-Palladium Project in Northwestern Ontario. The terms outline a loan of up to $11 million through Ontario’s Critic program to support this initiative. This collaboration marks a significant step forward for Generation Mining's 100%-owned Marathon Project.
